{{Quote|Only I can show my innermost self to others and not flinch under the scrutiny of their Fresnel lenses.|[[Unidentified Whiphid (Affirmation for Amber Day Six)|Unidentified Whiphid]]|<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>}}
A '''Fresnel lens''' was a type of lens. The work ''[[Affirmation for Amber Day Six: My Love Flows Ambiently and Infinitely]]'' made reference to these lenses.<ref name="MAGL" />

==Behind the scenes==
A [[Wikipedia:Fresnel lens|Fresnel lens]] is a type of lens that is divided into a set of concentric annular sections, originally developed by French physicist Augustin-Jean Fresnel for use in lighthouses.

Fresnel lenses were mentioned in a segment titled "Affirmation for Amber Day Six: My Love Flows Ambiently and Infinitely," written by [[Bob Carrau]] for the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that collects concept designs and photographs from various [[George Lucas]] projects.<ref name="MAGL" /> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in the book is [[Canon|non-canonical]].<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref>
